title: This Color Battle Changes Leaders 34 Times! 😳
description:
Four spokes split a disc into four colored wedges, and one ball bounces inside each wedge. Every time a ball hits a spoke it shoves that spoke away, and the shove is proportional to the size of the ball's own wedge: bigger wedge, bigger push. A small wedge gets hit more often but pushes weakly, so the borders swing back and forth instead of snowballing. The push multiplier on the hub grows 3% every second. A wedge squeezed under 14 degrees pops and its neighbors close the gap. The last color holding the whole circle wins.
Physics, picture and sound are generated by code (seed 88), with no footage, samples or stock media.
Which color did you pick?
#simulation #satisfying #physics
pinned_comment: Orange, teal, pink or lime: which color takes the whole circle? 🟠 🩵 🩷 🟢 Pick one before the first pop.
synthetic_media_disclosure_reason: Clearly stylized 2D animation of abstract shapes; nothing realistic that could be mistaken for real people, places or events.
